name: PolicyRenewalNotification
description: First-slice Boomi process: PolicyAdmin canonical XML → map PolicyRenewal_to_BrokerNotify → POST /v2/renewals. DEV only.
secrets: Do not copy BizTalk SSO credentials into this process or the map. Use a Boomi environment extension that references the existing SSO material.
openQuestions: status-R: StatusCode R is in DEV logs, not in the spec. Map rejects. No default status.
effectiveDate-timezone: UTC vs local unspecified. Date-only ISO-8601; no offset invented.
empty-BrokerCode: no default broker.id. Omit and let the target return 422.
Channel: no target field. Do not map.

shapes.example: PN-1009 StatusCode R — code not in table
PN-1010 missing broker.id — no default applied
